name: living-manual
description: Generate and maintain a branded, interactive user's manual from any codebase: clickable headings file notes that become developer tickets (optionally synced to Jira or GitHub Issues), roadmap previews show planned changes, a glossary explains concepts on first use, and readers reorder sections by dragging the contents, with the order kept by their browser or written back to the file. Installs a push-time guard so the manual always reflects the released app.
